name: rohan-portfolio
description: Explorable 3D portfolio for Md. Sakibul Hasan Rohan

comments.overrides.@dimforge/rapier3d-compat: ecctrl imports QueryFilterFlags straight from @dimforge/rapier3d-compat without declaring it, and npm resolves that to the 0.12 copy dragged in by @types/three. The physics world is built by @react-three/rapier against 0.19, so ecctrl ends up talking to a second, uninitialised WASM instance: its ground raycasts silently fail and the character never walks. Pinning one version keeps a single instance.
comments.overrides.sharp: @gltf-transform/cli pins sharp to ~0.34.5, which npm audit flags for four libvips CVEs. 0.35 is a drop-in here: the asset pipeline and the foliage atlas both produce byte-identical output on it.
comments.devDependencies.@gltf-transform/cli: Must stay on 4.x. `npm audit fix --force` will happily downgrade it to 2.5.1 to clear the remaining brace-expansion advisory; 2.x pulls in @squoosh/lib, which crashes on import under Node 18+ ('Cannot set property navigator'), so `npm run assets` stops working entirely. That advisory is a DoS in a build-time CLI parsing our own glob patterns — not worth breaking the toolchain for.
